t: This is the Budokwai, whose name means the Way of Knighthood Society. Founded in 1918, it is the oldest Japanese martial arts club in Europe, and it was the first judo club in Europe. Its founder, Gunji Koizumi, known to colleagues as G.K., introduced judo to the United Kingdom and became known as the Father of British Judo. He also helped establish the British Judo Association and founded the European Judo Union. At first the club taught jujutsu, kendo and other Japanese martial arts.
